stories.title: Prove GET /changes returns identities, stats, per-file rows and the secret patch policy
stories.scope: platform/src/index.ts computeChangeSet (406-508) and the GET /changes route (1112-1120); live worker https://nextgit-platform.john-b7d.workers.dev; agent-1 (patch row) and agent-5 (secret-class row); platform/CONTRACT.md GET /changes + Secret classes; no-clone guard over platform/src/index.ts and platform/src/land.ts.
stories.acceptance: GET /changes?repo=agent-1&base=demo&ref=main&baseRef=main returns ok:true with the base identity (repo demo, ref main, 40-hex treeHash) and head identity (repo agent-1), stats {files,added,modified,removed,additions,deletions} whose added+modified+removed sum equals files, and per-file rows: src/auth.ts modified +6/-0 carrying a patch. For agent-5 the single row config/.env is secret:true with keys exactly [DATABASE_URL,REDIS_URL], additions 2, no patch and no intent. No read route shells out to git or clones: no node:child_process in platform/src/index.ts, and git.clone/git.push occur only in platform/src/land.ts (the /land path).
stories.check_cmd: curl -sf 'https://nextgit-platform.john-b7d.workers.dev/changes?repo=agent-1&base=demo&ref=main&baseRef=main' | jq -ec '(.ok==true) and (.changeSet.base.repo=="demo") and (.changeSet.base.ref=="main") and (.changeSet.base.sha|test("^[0-9a-f]{40}$")) and (.changeSet.base.treeHash|test("^[0-9a-f]{40}$")) and (.changeSet.head.repo=="agent-1") and (.changeSet.head.ref=="main") and (.changeSet.head.treeHash|test("^[0-9a-f]{40}$")) and (.changeSet.stats.files>=1) and (.changeSet.stats.added + .changeSet.stats.modified + .changeSet.stats.removed == .changeSet.stats.files) and (.changeSet.stats.additions|type=="number") and (.changeSet.stats.deletions|type=="number") and ([.changeSet.files[]|select(.path=="src/auth.ts" and .status=="modified" and .additions==6 and .deletions==0 and (.patch|type=="string"))]|length==1)' && curl -sf 'https://nextgit-platform.john-b7d.workers.dev/changes?repo=agent-5&base=demo&ref=main&baseRef=main' | jq -ec '(.changeSet.files|length==1) and (.changeSet.files[0].path=="config/.env") and (.changeSet.files[0].secret==true) and (.changeSet.files[0].keys==["DATABASE_URL","REDIS_URL"]) and (.changeSet.files[0].additions==2) and (.changeSet.files[0].patch==null) and (.changeSet.files[0].intent==null)' && ! grep -q 'node:child_process' platform/src/index.ts && grep -q 'git\.clone' platform/src/land.ts && grep -q 'git\.push' platform/src/land.ts && ! grep -q 'git\.clone\|git\.push' platform/src/index.ts && [ -z "$(grep -rl 'git\.clone\|git\.push' platform/src | grep -v '^platform/src/land\.ts$')" ]

stories.title: Prove /land folds with the fork point as the 3-way ancestor
stories.scope: porting/tests/land-hardening.probe.mjs (scratch chain demo-lh-base -> agent-lh-1, never demo or agent-1..5); platform/src/index.ts computeMerge (304-305: ancestor = cs.base.sha fork-point texts) shared by /merge and /land; AD-3 reviewed heads.
stories.acceptance: /land evidence.ancestor[repo] equals the proposal's fork point while evidence.heads.base equals the fork point, the landed commit is a new sha the base remote resolves to, and a re-land of the same proposal after the base advanced folds to nothing (409 no-changes) - the fold is anchored at the fork point, not the moved base head. /merge runs the same computeMerge fold.
stories.notes: The probe is the repo's own suite and never touches demo; green run 2026-10-06 after wrangler whoami refreshed the OAuth token (it needs CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN or a fresh wrangler OAuth - a 401 authentication error means re-auth; transient TypeError: fetch failed runs were seen before the refresh). Asserts (a) ancestor = fork point, (b) base-advanced re-land -> 409 no-changes, (c) stale heads refused, (d) one winner + one 409 base-moved under double-land, (e) scratch cleanup. stories.title: Prove a change-set stays byte-identical after the baseline advances
stories.scope: New probe porting/tests/fork-point-stability.probe.mjs modeled on porting/tests/land-hardening.probe.mjs: scratch chain demo-e2s-base -> agent-e2s-1 (never demo or agent-1..5), push one commit, capture GET /changes, land the proposal into the scratch base (POST /land), capture GET /changes again, cmp the two response bodies byte-for-byte, delete both scratch repos on exit.
stories.acceptance: After the baseline advances (the proposal lands onto the scratch base, moving its head), the unchanged proposal's /changes body is byte-identical to the pre-land capture: same base.sha (the fork point), same stats, same per-file rows. Manually observed 2026-10-06 on scratch chain demo-e2s-base / agent-e2s-1: the two captures compared byte-identical (base.sha 6a5dac9707f4d28f92761cb23010afb45da1b327) while the base advanced to landing commit 219c90212124c68e0e9183877689aa66befd9d56.
stories.notes: The probe is this story deliverable; precedent for a check_cmd naming the script a story creates: row contract-smoke-verify-gates references the not-yet-existing porting/tests/contract-smoke.mjs. It needs CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN or a refreshed wrangler OAuth, same as land-hardening.probe.mjs. No existing store row covers the GET-side stability property. stories.title: Add per-fork commit list to /changes (worker + contract bump)
stories.scope: platform/src/index.ts computeChangeSet (406-508): add a commits[] array to the returned change-set - the fork's first-parent log from the head back to the fork point, newest first, so commits[0].hash === head.headSha - read through the repo capability's log() (ArtifactsCommitMetadata carries hash, author{name,email}, authoredAt/committedAt, message; worker-configuration.d.ts:11072-11100), no clones and no child_process, bounded by FORK_LOG_LIMIT=200. platform/CONTRACT.md GET /changes (13-34): document changeSet.commits[] additively and bump the version line before shipping; base/head/stats/files/texts unchanged.
stories.acceptance: GET /changes?repo=agent-1 returns changeSet.commits[] with >=1 entry whose hash equals the fork's head commit.
stories.check_cmd: FORK_HEAD=$(git -C /tmp/real-agents/agent-1 rev-parse main) && FORK_TREE=$(git -C /tmp/real-agents/agent-1 rev-parse 'main^{tree}') && curl -sf 'https://nextgit-platform.john-b7d.workers.dev/changes?repo=agent-1&base=demo&ref=main&baseRef=main' | node -e 'let b="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>b+=d).on("end",()=>{const die=m=>{console.error("FAIL: "+m);process.exit(1)};let j;try{j=JSON.parse(b)}catch(e){return die("response not JSON: "+b.slice(0,120))};const cs=j.changeSet||{};const head=process.argv[1],tree=process.argv[2];if(!Array.isArray(cs.commits)||cs.commits.length<1)return die("changeSet.commits[] missing or empty");const c=cs.commits[0];if(!/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/.test(c.hash||""))return die("commits[0].hash not 40-hex: "+c.hash);if(c.hash!==head)return die("commits[0].hash "+c.hash+" != fork log head "+head);if(typeof c.author!=="string"||!c.author)return die("commits[0].author missing");if(c.timestamp==null||c.timestamp==="")return die("commits[0].timestamp missing");if(typeof c.message!=="string")return die("commits[0].message missing");if(cs.head&&cs.head.treeHash&&cs.head.treeHash!==tree)return die("clone stale: head.treeHash "+cs.head.treeHash+" != local "+tree);for(const x of cs.commits){if(!/^[0-9a-f]{40}$/.test(x.hash||"")||typeof x.author!=="string"||!x.author||x.timestamp==null||typeof x.message!=="string")return die("commit entry incomplete: "+JSON.stringify(x))}console.log("OK commits[0]="+c.hash+" entries="+cs.commits.length)})' "$FORK_HEAD" "$FORK_TREE"
